projectDescription: A bun-first CLI that scaffolds a Turborepo monorepo by orchestrating official framework generators — wiring together a web app, mobile app, API, and backend in one command.
keyFeatures: One-command Turborepo monorepo scaffolding with bun
Interactive prompts or fully flag-driven non-interactive mode
Official framework generators (Next.js, SvelteKit, Expo, Hono, Convex)
Automatic workspace stitching: shared configs, ports, lockfile, package names
groot add: grow an existing workspace with additional scaffolds
groot doctor: health checks with actionable fix suggestions
Preset support: replicate a workspace shape from groot.json
Machine-readable --dry-run --json output for CI and agents
Standalone binary installers (Linux/macOS/Windows) — no Bun required to run
Exit codes and --json contracts covered by semver
publicApiSurface: groot init [dir] — plant a new bun-first Turborepo workspace
groot add <scaffold> — grow an existing workspace with a new scaffold
groot doctor [dir] — run health checks with suggested fixes
bun create groot <dir> — bun create shorthand routed to init
bunx create-groot@latest init <dir> — explicit npm invocation
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 internal, 2 usage, 3 preflight, 4 generator, 5 stitch/verify, 130 cancelled
